# Trendora

Trendora is an English-language visual lifestyle publication focused on useful, image-led guides for home, beauty, food, fashion, DIY and seasonal living.

## Primary pages
- https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/
- https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/about.html
- https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/editorial-policy.html

## Current guides
- 21 Home Café Ideas & Coffee Recipes That Make Mornings Feel Like a Coffee Shop: https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/home-cafe-coffee-ideas/
- 19 Perfume Layering Ideas That Smell Expensive and Completely Unique: https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/perfume-layering-ideas/
- 17 Kitchen Witch & Herbal Apothecary Ideas That Make a Kitchen Feel Magical: https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/kitchen-witch-herbal-apothecary/
- 21 Milky Lilac Nail Ideas That Look Soft, Glossy and Expensive: https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/milky-lilac-nails/

## Editorial notes
Trendora may use AI-assisted drafting and research. Published guides are reviewed for clarity, image-to-text relevance, internal consistency and obvious safety issues. Commercial relationships are disclosed.
